first.rationale: I intend to simplify onboarding because both activation and onboarding completion are declining, and prior evidence supports improvements in completion, time-to-value, and SMB first-week activation. I would verify the two most directly relevant records before committing, while guarding against optimizing completion at the expense of qualified downstream revenue. A small guarded test is appropriate given the limited slot and the need to monitor activation quality, meaningful product actions, conversion, and retention rather than completion alone.
